title: 3 construction workers killed in water tank collapse in Cagayan

blocks.text: TUGUEGARAO CITY — Three construction workers died after a water tank collapsed on them while they were working at a facility under construction in Barangay Simayung, Abulug, Cagayan, on Thursday morning, Nov. 19. The Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) in Abulug said the workers were welding beneath the water tank when the heavy structure suddenly gave way, trapping them underneath. Responders from the BFP, the Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office, police and barangay officials used an excavator to lift the collapsed tank and retrieve the workers.
